title: SRS Revision Sidecar (ext:addressability)
description: Per-record field-revision history. The sidecar file sits beside its record under a reserved instance root, with the record's base name and the .revisions.json suffix — records/<name>.json pairs with records/<name>.revisions.json. A Revision is an addressable, append-only snapshot of one FieldValue at a point in time; the sidecar is the storage form, not a separate entity. RFC-038 [R9] makes an unclassifiable object under a reserved instance root an error, and this schema — owed by RFC-038's Schema-changes table and landed by the #297 cutover — is what classifies it. A sidecar whose recordId resolves to no instance is an orphan and an error (RFC-038 acceptance test 10).

$schema.description: Optional schema declaration. When present it must name this schema.

recordId.description: The instanceId of the record this history belongs to. Must equal every entry's recordId, and must resolve to an instance in the repository.

revisions.description: Append-only. Entries chain through priorRevisionId; chains must be acyclic and stay within one recordId/fieldId pair (Invariant 33).

revisionId.description: Stable identity of this snapshot. Addressable as {fieldId}/{revisionId}.

recordId.description: The record whose field this snapshot belongs to. Equals the sidecar's recordId.

fieldId.description: The Field whose value this snapshot captures.

value.description: The FieldValue at this point in time. Shape follows the Field's fieldType (RFC-032/RFC-039), so it is not constrained here.

priorRevisionId.description: The previous Revision for the same recordId/fieldId pair. Absent on the first snapshot (Invariant 33).

sourceRefs.description: SourceReferences to the conversation material that produced this change.

RevisionAgent.description: Who or what authored this revision. A tagged object — `type` is the tag; `importSource` is admissible only alongside the Imported tag.

importSource.description: Identifier of the system the revision was imported from.

RevisionProvenance.description: Optional contextual metadata. Every property is optional; an empty object is admissible.

lifecycleTransition.description: The lifecycle state this revision was created transitioning to (ext:lifecycle).
